metadata.title: Flight Delay Intelligence
metadata.subtitle: Operational Performance & Delay Drivers
metadata.tagline: Turning flight data into smoother journeys

recommendations.title: Protect high-risk departure windows
recommendations.description: Increase staffing and monitoring during 4 PM - 8 PM when delays peak.

recommendations.title: Target hub bottlenecks
recommendations.description: Focus on operational improvements at high-delay airports (e.g. ATL, ORD, LAX) through better resource planning.

recommendations.title: Increase turnaround buffer
recommendations.description: Add buffer time for aircraft and crews on routes with high late-aircraft propagation to reduce cascading delays.
